card.name: Dose adjustment wording before a target amount
card.fires_on: Small words such as "to", "a" or "rate" right where a dose is being adjusted toward a target level, such as "reduced to the lowest" or "increase to the maintenance dosage". It also fires inside dosing-table numbers and ranges.

modes.label: Adjust to a target
modes.description: "to" after reduce or increase, before the lowest, maintenance or maximum dosage.
modes.example: the dosage should be reduced<< to>> the lowest possible amount of drug and to

modes.label: Rate or amount wording
modes.description: A word in an infusion or dose instruction where the amount is set by a recommendation.
modes.example: Administer by continuous infusion at the<< rate>> recommended in Table 1.

modes.label: Dosing table numbers
modes.description: Spaces or digits inside weight or dose ranges in tables.

card.writes: It pushes toward words like "determine" and "determination" and away from "design", as in "dose to be determined".
card.plain: It marks spots in dosing text where the dose is being raised or lowered to a set level, or where a table range is written.
